palette: 坯布米 cloth + 靛蓝 indigo + 茜草红 madder + 姜黄 turmeric + 媒染灰 mordant
typography: heavy vat headings, square swatch chips, mordant label blocks, double-frame swatch verdicts
composition: a dye house where each sentence adjustment grades a cloth: four grade vats in a row, recidivist gates, a surrender desk with six ways, and the merge-probation yard
surface: woven cloth grain, vat stains, square dye swatches, dashed rinse zones, double-frame stamps; no glossy panels
motion: cloths enter vat by vat in severity order, gates stamp the four checks, swatches land as verdicts; no idle loops
transition: the cloth grain persists while each scene re-dyes the bench
